description: Command: start one of the device's playlists (Hub #918), from controller v1's `media.start`. The envelope subject names the device; the payload names no device, controller, address or credential. The optional `expectedConfigurationRevision` and `expectedGeneration` refuse the request with `revision-conflict` when the device's configuration revision or generation has moved on. The module refuses an operation the device does not offer with `unsupported-capability` (`commandSupported`). The reply and the outcome use the profile's reply and outcome payloads.
